knowledge:
- key_parameters: vcfFilename=Character string or vector of the input VCF file path(s) ;; pedFilename=Character string of the PED file path containing pedigree information, required for inheritance models ;; allTranscripts=Logical indicating whether to use all transcripts (default FALSE) or only principal ones ;; regionAnnotations=List of genomic regions to annotate (e.g., CodingVariants(), IntronVariants()) ;; otherAnnotations=Character vector of additional annotation packages/objects (e.g., MafDb, PolyPhen, SIFT) ;; groupBy=Argument in allVariants() to group variants by a specific annotation column ;; method=Argument in summary() (e.g., "bioc", "SOfull") to control the ontology/vocabulary of the summary
- alternatives: VariantAnnotation package (specifically locateVariants() and predictCoding()) can be used directly if custom low-level annotation is preferred without the inheritance model filtering framework.
- when_to_use: Use this package when analyzing NGS variant data (VCF files) from a family (trio/pedigree) or unrelated individuals to identify disease-causing variants under specific inheritance models (dominant, recessive, compound heterozygous, X-linked, de novo) or shared variants.
- pitfalls: Running inheritance model functions (like autosomalRecessiveHomozygous()) without providing a valid PED file in VariantFilteringParam() will fail or yield incorrect results ;; By default, all functional annotation filters are inactive (FALSE); users must explicitly activate them using active(filters(obj)) <- TRUE or select specific ones to apply filtering ;; summary() might return 0 rows for a specific SO term if no variants are directly annotated to it, unless method="SOfull" is used to aggregate up the hierarchical tree.

workflows.name: unrelated_individuals_analysis
workflows.intent: Annotate and filter variants from unrelated individuals without assuming an inheritance model.
input: NA12878.subset.bam, NA12891.subset.bam, NA12892.subset.bam (optional BAM files for visualization)
workflows.stages: 1. Create parameter object using VariantFilteringParam() ;; 2. Annotate variants using unrelatedIndividuals() ;; 3. Summarize annotations using summary() ;; 4. Set BAM files and plot variant support using bamFiles() and plot() ;; 5. Filter variants by modifying active filters and cutoffs using filters(), cutoffs(), and change() ;; 6. Retrieve filtered variants using filteredVariants() ;; 7. Export results using reportVariants()
workflows.code:
library(VariantFiltering)
CEUvcf <- file.path(system.file("extdata", package="VariantFiltering"), "CEUtrio.vcf.bgz")
vfpar <- VariantFilteringParam(CEUvcf)
uind <- unrelatedIndividuals(vfpar)
summary(uind)
summary(uind, method="bioc")
uindSO <- summary(uind, method="SOfull")
allVariants(uind)
path2bams <- file.path(system.file("extdata", package="VariantFiltering"), paste0(samples(uind), ".subset.bam"))
bv <- BamViews(bamPaths=path2bams, bamSamples=DataFrame(row.names=samples(uind)))
bamFiles(uind) <- bv
plot(uind, what="rs6130959", sampleName="NA12892")
samples(uind) <- c("NA12891", "NA12892")
uind <- resetSamples(uind)
filters(uind)
active(filters(uind)) <- TRUE
change(cutoffs(uind), "SOterms") <- "UTR_variant"
active(filters(uind))["SOterms"] <- TRUE
change(cutoffs(uind)$maxMAF, "popmask") <- FALSE
change(cutoffs(uind)$maxMAF, "maxvalue") <- 0.01
filteredVariants(uind)
reportVariants(uind, type="csv", file="uind.csv")

workflows.name: inheritance_models_analysis
workflows.intent: Filter variants that segregate according to specific inheritance models using pedigree information.
workflows.stages: 1. Create parameter object with both VCF and PED files using VariantFilteringParam() ;; 2. Filter variants using inheritance model functions: autosomalRecessiveHomozygous(), autosomalRecessiveHeterozygous(), autosomalDominant(), xLinked(), or deNovo()
workflows.code:
library(VariantFiltering)
CEUvcf <- file.path(system.file("extdata", package="VariantFiltering"), "CEUtrio.vcf.bgz")
CEUped <- file.path(system.file("extdata", package="VariantFiltering"), "CEUtrio.ped")
param <- VariantFilteringParam(vcfFilenames=CEUvcf, pedFilename=CEUped)
